query:
-- 查詢 #BOXIUM-180001 商品詳情
SELECT id, listing_no, title, status, stock, sold_count, seller_id
FROM marketplace_listings
WHERE listing_no = 'BOXIUM-180001';

-- 查詢所有與 BOXIUM-180001 相關的訂單
SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.status, o.listing_id, o.batch_ref, o.created_at, o.updated_at
FROM marketplace_orders o
JOIN marketplace_listings l ON o.listing_id = l.id
WHERE l.listing_no = 'BOXIUM-180001'
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC;
